allow: Bash(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); print\('Default branch:', d.get\('default_branch'\)\); print\('Private:', d.get\('private'\)\); print\('Has issues:', d.get\('has_issues'\)\)")

Bash(node -e "let d=''; process.stdin.on\('data',c=>d+=c\); process.stdin.on\('end',\(\)=>{const r=JSON.parse\(d\); console.log\('Branch:',r.default_branch,'| Issues:',r.has_issues,'| Private:',r.private\)}\)")
Bash(node -e "let d=''; process.stdin.on\('data',c=>d+=c\); process.stdin.on\('end',\(\)=>{const r=JSON.parse\(d\); console.log\('Login:',r.login,'| Email:',r.email\)}\)")
